About the Role

VetComm is looking for an experienced GoHighLevel Systems Administrator to manage the cloud-based systems that power our operations.

DIRECT, HANDS-ON GOHIGHLEVEL ADMINISTRATION EXPERIENCE IS MANDATORY.

Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, or another CRM does not replace the GoHighLevel requirement. Applicants without direct professional GoHighLevel administration experience will not be considered.

This is not a software developer, prototype developer, network engineer, or traditional helpdesk position. You will be responsible for GoHighLevel CRM administration, Google Workspace, Twilio SMS and voice systems, Identity and Access Management, SaaS applications, workflow automation, and employee technical support.

You will report to the Director of Data and Systems and help keep VetComm’s business-critical systems secure, organized, connected, and operating reliably.

What You’ll Do

Own the daily administration and optimization of GoHighLevel
Manage GoHighLevel users, roles, permissions, pipelines, opportunities, workflows, calendars, forms, and integrations
Build, troubleshoot, test, and improve GoHighLevel workflows and automations
Diagnose GoHighLevel email, calendar, telephony, workflow, data, and integration problems
Administer Google Workspace users, groups, permissions, security settings, onboarding, and offboarding
Manage Identity and Access Management across company systems
Administer Twilio SMS and voice systems, including A2P 10DLC compliance
Build and maintain automations using Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar tools
Troubleshoot CRM, email, access, SaaS, and system-integration issues
Provide technical systems support to a fully remote workforce
Maintain system documentation, access records, procedural guides, and SOPs
Coordinate with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve business-system issues

Mandatory Qualifications

Direct, hands-on professional experience administering GoHighLevel
Experience managing GoHighLevel users, permissions, pipelines, workflows, calendars, and integrations
Professional Google Workspace administration experience
Experience managing employee accounts, permissions, security, onboarding, and offboarding
Experience administering multiple SaaS business applications
Working knowledge of Identity and Access Management practices
Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills
Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment within the United States

Applicants whose CRM experience is limited to Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, or another non-GoHighLevel platform do not meet the mandatory GoHighLevel requirement.

Preferred Experience

Two or more years of direct GoHighLevel administration
Twilio SMS and voice administration
A2P 10DLC registration and compliance
Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar automation platforms
APIs, webhooks, or light scripting for integrations and troubleshooting
Experience supporting a distributed workforce
Experience documenting business systems, workflows, access controls, and operating procedures

Why This Role

This is a fully remote, high-ownership position for an experienced GoHighLevel administrator who wants to work across CRM administration, Google Workspace, Twilio, SaaS management, security, automation, and employee support.
